def render(t):

    dx=50*t-.65*t*t
    cx=CX+dx;cy=CY+.13*dx
    r=RADIUS*(1+.00075*dx)
    theta=np.log(1+.00075*dx)/(.00075*RADIUS)*np.sqrt(1+.13**2)

    a=alpha*visibility

    return np.uint8(np.clip(np.rint(base),0,255))
